thread:
emily (Design): quick q — the error-context tooltip in request drilldown is super dense. thinking we split export out of the inline tooltip and move it to the top header toolbar. thoughts?

raj (Product): agree, tooltip is noisy. header-level 'Export trace' makes sense. but we should keep a tiny inline affordance for power users (like a kebab menu with 'Export view').

emily (Design): yeah. header primary 'Export trace' + in-tooltip links: 'Copy request id' and 'Open full trace'. avoid 'snapshot' wording.

maria (Eng): fyi implementation: header export needs server to capture filters+time-range when user hits export. adds ~200ms to job. ok if product owns SLAs.

liam (A11y): a11y: export control must be keyboard reachable, have descriptive aria-label including request id e.g. 'Export trace (request: 89a4f2)'. ensure focus returns after modal closes.

emily (Design): proposed tooltip copy to shorten:

"Error context — top frames and request metadata. Click to expand stack and copy request id."

and header CTA: 'Export trace' with chevron menu for JSON/HAR.

raj (Product): prefer default file = JSON (trace+metadata). microcopy under export: 'Includes filters, time range, and visible stack frames.'

maria (Eng): backend will attach metadata blob. HAR opt-in. ok.

emily (Design): layout question: place Export on the right with filters/time-range grouping. keeps actions together.

liam (A11y): right is fine for visual scan, but DOM order should place it before overflow menu for keyboard users. contrast check: ensure button meets 4.5:1.

raj (Product): propose keyboard shortcut Shift+E to open export modal. add to command palette.

maria (Eng): Shift+E fine, will validate against other bindings.

emily (Design): I'll push Figma screens with export on right and slim tooltip, tag you.

ui-bot: deploy-preview up: https://ui-stage.redwood.ai/trace-export-170102 — includes keyboard demo and JSON export.

raj (Product): I'll update the copy doc to 'Export trace' + microcopy and schedule quick sign-off tomorrow 10am.

emily (Design): works for me.

maria (Eng): works.

liam (A11y): I'll bring the a11y checklist. :thumbsup:
